BiblicalUsage: A termination is the end of a thing: thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, in the two ends of the mercy seat, and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof, and from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other wing were ten cubits.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the ends as the measure of the holy things, where the gold and the brass are counted to the last cubit.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
